items.title: IT Support Intern
items.desc:
• Support candidate recruitment processes from processing and screening applicant data through recruitment platforms based on HRD criteria, compiling candidate information and documents, coordinating interview schedules and formats (online/offline), to reporting compiled results to support the selection stages.
• Contribute to quality control, validation, and alignment of outsourcing project billing administration documents across multiple clients, including a national tier-1 telecommunications client (20 files totaling over IDR 300 million) and a multinational FMCG manufacturing company, by verifying operational attachments, standardizing legal document formats, and reconciling data to support billing accuracy.
• Support processing, standardization, and synchronization of outsourced workforce operational data for a national tier-1 telecommunications project (over 150 personnel across dozens of POs) and a construction and infrastructure partner company through cross-system attendance validation (digital attendance app, shift schedules, and timesheets), while contributing to enhancing an interactive Excel-based counseling form using XLOOKUP and dynamic data validation.

items.title: AI/ML & Full-Stack Developer (STEDI)
items.desc:
• Contributed to developing STEDI: Pre-Diagnostic Screening Assistant for Elderly Health Posts, advancing the innovation to the National Finals of the 38th Pekan Ilmiah Mahasiswa Nasional (PIMNAS) under the Student Creativity Program for Innovative Works (PKM-KI).
• As part of the team, helped scale the project to an international level, securing a US$3,150 humanitarian technology grant from EPICS in IEEE (Jon C. Taenzer Memorial Fund).
• Officially registered as a co-inventor in the Industrial Design Intellectual Property Rights (HKI) for the STEDI Monitor Box physical device.

items.title: Full-Stack Developer (E-Growth)
items.desc:
• Developed functional components for E-Growth: Digital Growth Monitoring Platform, a web-based system integrated with the F-Scale pediatric measurement device to centralize patient data.
• Implemented automated foot-arch detection and classification (flatfoot, normal, and cavus foot) using Clarke's Angle calculation and digital image processing.
• Evaluated and validated the system on 180 children aged 2–7 years across TK & Daycare Habibie Ainun and Posyandu Kemuning in Semarang, achieving 98.89% diagnostic accuracy against conventional wet footprint tests (published at SINTA 2 JTI).

items.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
items.desc:
• Developed four web-based systems: RENSTRA FT for faculty strategic planning, Portfolio MK FT for course material management, UMKM Repro for supply chain management, and Medical Checkup FT for health data management.
• Collaborated with lecturers and faculty stakeholders to identify system requirements, develop features, and tailor application functionality to operational and academic needs.
• Participated in web application development and maintenance, covering database design, API implementation, and user interface development to support workflow digitalization across the faculty.
